steps.description: AC-1: Verify `.cursor/agents/security.mdc` exists and defines persona, inputs, outputs, and artifact responsibilities.
AC-2: Verify `.cursor/commands/security-review.md` defines both design and code review steps.
AC-3: Verify `SECURITY_REVIEW` and `COMPLIANCE_PROFILES` flags exist and control activation behavior.
AC-4: Verify zero-overhead path when `SECURITY_REVIEW=0` (security steps are skipped).
AC-5: Verify design review scope checks architecture decisions, data flow, auth patterns, and selected profiles.
AC-6: Verify code review scope checks secrets, injection, auth/authz, and profile-specific requirements.
AC-7: Verify findings are written to `docs/engineering/security-review.md` with severity, affected component, and remediation.
AC-8: Verify workflow integration invokes security review at architecture/execute checkpoints when enabled.
AC-9: Verify critical findings trigger decision records and block progression until resolved.
AC-10: Verify template parity includes security agent, command, and security review artifact updates.
